description: The longer candidate need not have an eligible proof tree. On A B C, r reads y as A, leaves out [T], and reads B C. y → A z [U] C over A B C is longer, though its only proof leaves out [U] after z → B, which the longer z → B C forbids. It still forbids the omission of [T], so begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A B C
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [++T] B C
%rule y A | A z [++U] C
%rule z B | B C
